run_main_templama: run the main function to download and preprocess TempLAMA dataset for specified years
run_prep_question: run prep_question to replace _X_ placeholders with extra_id_0 tokens in a query string
run_maybe_download_data: run maybe_download_data to download train valid and test splits from Google Storage
run_parse: run _parse to read a JSONL file and group items by query for specific years
run_get_export_obj: run _get_export_obj to transform a raw TempLAMA item into an export-ready dictionary
